title: Relocation Entitlements by Rate Plan (Room Reservations)
content:
When a hotel relocates a Room Reservations guest to another hotel, three entitlements follow the rate plan: whether the hotel pays the first night at the alternate hotel, whether prepayments and advance deposits held for the relocated reservation are refunded in full, and whether an Ashbury Rewards member relocated on the plan qualifies for relocation compensation points.

| Rate plan | Hotel pays the first night at the alternate hotel | Prepayments and advance deposits refunded in full | Member qualifies for relocation compensation points |
|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Flexible Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Member Flexible Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Group Block Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Reward Night Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |

All three entitlements apply on all eight rate plans; no plan is excluded from any of them, the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate included.
